children.name: Hemitheconyx
children.description: Hemitheconyx — a genus of eyelid geckos in the family Eublepharidae.

children.name: Hemitheconyx caudicinctus
children.description: The African fat-tailed gecko or fat-tail gecko (Hemitheconyx caudicinctus) is a ground-dwelling species of gecko from West Africa and Cameroon.

children.name: Hemitheconyx taylori
children.description: Taylor's fat-tailed gecko (Hemitheconyx taylori), also known commonly as Taylor's fat-tail gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Eublepharidae. The species is native to northeastern Africa.

children.name: Aeluroscalabotes
children.description: Aeluroscalabotes — a genus of eyelid geckos in the family Eublepharidae.

children.name: Aeluroscalabotes felinus
children.description: The cat gecko (Aeluroscalabotes felinus) is a species of gecko found in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Cambodia and Thailand.

children.name: Goniurosaurus
children.description: Goniurosaurus — a genus of eyelid geckos in the family Eublepharidae.

children.name: Goniurosaurus araneus
children.description: The Vietnamese leopard gecko or Chinese tiger gecko (Goniurosaurus araneus) is a species of lizards in the family Eublepharidae. It is found in the Cao Bằng Province of Vietnam and Guangxi in China. The scientific species name, is from the Latin, aranea, which means "spider", due to the spindly, spider-like form of this species.

children.name: Goniurosaurus bawanglingensis
children.description: Goniurosaurus bawanglingensis is a species of geckos endemic to the Hainan Bawangling National Nature Reserve in the southwest part of Hainan Island, China.

children.name: Goniurosaurus catbaensis
children.description: Goniurosaurus catbaensis, also known as the Cat Ba leopard gecko or Cat Ba tiger gecko is a gecko endemic to Cát Bà Island in Vietnam.

children.name: Goniurosaurus hainanensis
children.description: Goniurosaurus hainanensis is a nocturnal species of gecko endemic to the Hainan Island of China.

children.name: Goniurosaurus huuliensis
children.description: Goniurosaurus huuliensis is a gecko endemic to Vietnam.

children.name: Goniurosaurus kuroiwae
children.description: Kuroiwa's ground gecko (Goniurosaurus kuroiwae), also known commonly as Kuroiwa's eyelid gecko, Kuroiwa's leopard gecko, the Okinawan ground gecko, the Ryukyu eyelid gecko, and the Tokashiki gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Eublepharidae. The species is endemic to the Okinawa Islands in the Ryukyu Archipelago, Japan.

children.name: Goniurosaurus kwangsiensis
children.description: Goniurosaurus kwangsiensis, sometimes known as the Guangxi cave gecko, is a gecko endemic to China.

children.name: Goniurosaurus liboensis
children.description: Goniurosaurus liboensis is a species of geckos endemic to China.

children.name: Goniurosaurus lichtenfelderi
children.description: Lichtenfelder's gecko (Goniurosaurus lichtenfelderi) is a species of lizard in the family Eublepharidae. The species is native to southeastern Asia.

children.name: Goniurosaurus luii
children.description: Goniurosaurus luii is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Eublepharidae.

children.name: Goniurosaurus orientalis
children.description:
The spotted ground gecko or Japanese cave gecko (Goniurosaurus orientalis) is a gecko endemic to the Ryukyu Islands, Japan. Goniurosaurus orientalis is found in four small islands in the Okinawa group: Tonaki Island, Tokashiki Island, Ie Island, and Aka Island.
This particular species grows up to 16 cm and it has deep red eyes. Its basic color is dark brown or black with an orange or red pattern.

children.name: Goniurosaurus splendens
children.description: The banded ground gecko (Goniurosaurus splendens) is a gecko. It is endemic to Tokunoshima in the Ryukyu Islands of Japan.

children.name: Goniurosaurus toyamai
children.description: Goniurosaurus toyamai, also called commonly the Iheja ground gecko, the Iheyajima leopard gecko, and Toyama's ground gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Eublepharidae.

children.name: Goniurosaurus yamashinae
children.description: Yamashina's ground gecko (Goniurosaurus yamashinae) is a species of gecko. It is endemic to Kume Island in the Ryukyu Islands of Japan.

children.name: Goniurosaurus yingdeensis
children.description: Goniurosaurus yingdeensis, also called the Yingde leopard gecko, is a gecko endemic to China.

children.name: Goniurosaurus zhelongi
children.description: Goniurosaurus zhelongi, also called the Zhe-long's leopard gecko, is a gecko endemic to China.

children.name: Coleonyx
children.description: Coleonyx — a genus of eyelid geckos in the family Eublepharidae.

children.name: Coleonyx brevis
children.description: The Texas banded gecko (Coleonyx brevis) is a species of small gecko native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico.

children.name: Coleonyx elegans
children.description:
The Yucatán banded gecko (Coleonyx elegans) is a species of geckos found in Mexico, Guatemala, and Belize.
It is a common inhabitant of forested and open habitats throughout Yucatan Peninsula. It is terrestrial and largely nocturnal. It feeds on invertebrates, including spiders, crickets and beetles, and is non venomous and harmless, despite being highly feared and avoided by many locals.

children.name: Coleonyx fasciatus
children.description: The black banded gecko (Coleonyx fasciatus) is a gecko endemic to western Mexico. It is found in Madrean foothills in Sinaloa and southern Sonora, and perhaps in extreme adjacent southwestern Chihuahua.

children.name: Coleonyx gypsicolus
children.description: Coleonyx gypsicolus, sometimes called the Isla San Marcos barefoot banded gecko is a gecko endemic to Isla San Marcos in Mexico.

children.name: Coleonyx mitratus
children.description: The Central American banded gecko (Coleonyx mitratus) is a species of moderately-sized gecko in the genus Coleonyx, native to Central America and first identified by Wilhelm Peters in 1863. It is a member of the eyelid geckos.

children.name: Coleonyx reticulatus
children.description: The reticulate banded gecko or reticulated gecko (Coleonyx reticulatus) is a species of small gecko native to the United States (Texas) and Mexico (Coahuila).

children.name: Coleonyx switaki
children.description: Switak's banded gecko (Coleonyx switaki), also commonly known as the barefoot banded gecko, the barefoot gecko, and Switak's barefoot gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Eublepharidae. The species is indigenous to the extreme southwestern United States and adjacent northwestern Mexico.

children.name: Coleonyx variegatus
children.description: The western banded gecko is a species of lizard in the family Eublepharidae. The species is native to the southwestern United States and adjacent northwestern Mexico. Five subspecies are recognized.

children.name: Coleonyx virens
children.description: Phylogenetic relationships for four species within the genus were assessed by Jonniaux and Kumazawa (2008). Among Eublepharidae the karyotype is known for 4 species only: C. switaki (2 n = 24; FN = 26) (Murphy 1974), C. variegatus (2 n = 32; FN = 32) (Matthey 1933; Porter et al. 1994), Eublepharis macularius (2 n = 38; FN = 38) (Gorman 1973), and Goniurosaurus kuroiwae (2 n = 24) (Ota et al. 1987).

children.name: Holodactylus
children.description: Holodactylus — a genus of eyelid geckos in the family Eublepharidae.

children.name: Holodactylus africanus

children.name: Holodactylus cornii
children.description: Holodactylus cornii, also known as the East African clawed gecko, is a species of gecko that is endemic to Somalia in Eastern Africa.

children.name: Eublepharis
children.description: Eublepharis — a genus of eyelid geckos in the family Eublepharidae.

children.name: Eublepharis angramainyu
children.description: Eublepharis angramainyu, also known as the Iranian fat-tailed gecko, Iranian eyelid gecko or Iraqi eyelid gecko, is a nocturnal ground-dwelling lizard native to Iraq, Iran, Turkey and Syria.

children.name: Eublepharis fuscus
children.description: The West Indian leopard gecko (Eublepharis fuscus) is a species of leopard gecko found in western India, with its range possibly extending to southeastern Pakistan. The specific name "fuscus" means dark or dusky.

children.name: Eublepharis hardwickii
children.description: The East Indian leopard gecko (Eublepharis hardwickii), also known commonly as Hardwicke's gecko, is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Eublepharidae. The species is endemic to India and Bangladesh.

children.name: Eublepharis macularius
children.description: The leopard gecko or common leopard gecko (Eublepharis macularius) is a ground-dwelling gecko native primarily to the rocky dry grassland and desert regions of Afghanistan, Iran, Pakistan, India, and Nepal.

children.name: Eublepharis satpuraensis
children.description: Eublepharis satpuraensis, sometimes called the Satpura leopard gecko, is a species of gecko.

children.name: Eublepharis turcmenicus
children.description: The Turkmenistan eyelid gecko or Turkmenian eyelid gecko (Eublepharis turcmenicus) is a ground-dwelling lizard native to Turkmenistan and northern Iran. It inhabits rocky and stony foothills and slopes at elevations up to above sea level. It is oviparous, typically laying clutches of two eggs. Mainly insectivorous, it may also eat smaller vertebrates. Like many other lizards has the ability to shed its tail (autotomy).
